answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the summit graph. Re-attestations are stored in canyon and grove lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 923 impostors cost 1007 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
